issue: English 'But the shepherd's dog...' has no slot for 'but' (asyndeton); otherwise ok. wénHm̥ AOR 1SG 'I have grown fond' fine.

déh₃ut is AOR 3SG of the LIV-uncertain root deh₃w- (Lat. duit), while déh₃t (deh₃-) is used elsewhere in the batch; h₂wékst AOR under 'grows up quickly' (gnomic, acceptable). kʷrinéh₂t is the imperfect, not an aorist, under 'bought'.
dṓm moy ne h₁ési: h₁ési is 2SG 'you are'; 'I have no home' needs 3SG h₁ésti (person error).
mélh₃t and méwdt are aorists under present English ('comes forth', 'grows glad'); defensible as gnomic/inceptive, but the tense does not match the English.
ph₂teres (unaccented NOM.PL 'fathers') for NOM.SG ph₂tḗr in 'My father and mother came' (gʷm̥tā́m 3DU fits father+mother). Also tóybʰos DAT.PL after the dual tóh₁ (minor number inconsistency).
préḱsdʰi s-aorist imperative is unusual but formed.
méh₂term̥ moy stérgetes: stérgetes is PRS 2DU/3DU; the user's sentence 'I love my mother' needs 1SG stérgoh₂ (as the model's echo has).
stóygʰoh₁ toy h₁wésus h₁syéh₁t: stóygʰoh₁ is INS.SG/DU; subject of 'May your way be good' needs NOM.SG stóygʰos (agreeing with h₁wésus).
smimń̥bʰos (DAT/INS.PL of sméymn̥) zero-grade root is engine paradigm; fine.
gʷegʷóme PRF 3SG 'has come', póntoh₁i LOC of póntoh₁s.
h₁éy is the engine's alternate NOM.SG.M anaphoric (agrees with h₂énh₁mos).
déh₃ut (deh₃w-, LIV-uncertain) for 'gave' where déh₃t is standard; h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr is a fine Ved. dātā vasūnām echo.
séngʷm̥ is AOR 1SG of sengʷ- 'sink' under 'I fell into the water' (stretched: 'I sank'). nésomedʰh₂ 1PL middle matches 'we went back home'.
